purpose: Teach: 激戦/欠損/直観/天災/幻覚/無期/呪縛/避妊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、近代の激戦地の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the fierce battlefields of the modern era, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested opening. Slight upward lilt on her name—acknowledging her. Calm pacing, inviting. Steady gaze that says she's read the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、人口減少による地域の欠損を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the regional decline caused by population loss.
lines.style: Direct, careful. A slight pause before the dash, gathering her thoughts. Measured delivery. Testing whether the teacher sees what she was trying to do.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 直観に頼った判断の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You explored decisions based on intuition, if I remember right?
lines.style: Gently probing. Slight tilt of her head. Not pushing—genuinely curious about how Sakura would correct her. Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、天災に備える社会システムを論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about social systems for preparing against natural disasters.
lines.style: Slight defensiveness underneath, but controlled. A quiet correction delivered with respect. She's not irritated, just clarifying what matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 幻覚症状を伴う精神疾患を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Mental illness with hallucinatory symptoms was another topic you covered?
lines.style: Curious, leaning slightly forward. She's connecting dots—not testing. Real interest in where Sakura's mind goes. Open, warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、無期懲役と仮釈放の判例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my paper was on case law around life sentences and parole.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. No apology in the correction. She chose this topic for a reason and she holds it. Brief exhale after the dash.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の呪縛から解放される運動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And then liberation from social constraints—that was your focus?
lines.style: Reflective, slower pace. Listening more than asking. She's giving Sakura space to own what she's written. Genuine curiosity about the through-line.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、避妊普及の社会史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—the social history of contraceptive access and adoption.
lines.style: Direct finish. A small sense of completion in her voice. She's said what she needed to say. Slight softening at the end—relief that the correction is done.
